title: centaurea leucantha
intro: Centaurea leucantha, commonly known as White Cockle or White Knawel, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea leucantha include its ability to reduce pain, lower fever, and aid in wound healing, attributed to its therapeutic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
